title: Ideas inventory audit residuals and selected world-gap tranche
head: be24c225c00cf8c583bf7773ee124d354b91e88b

reviews.classification: partial actual audit/world-gap crosswalk review; dated candidate and later harness bounds preserved
reviews.disposition:
F1: Actual new review covers original511–620: equivalence EL1/EL6/EL7; domain-conformance DRC5–DRC15 listed/residual groups; UIA4/UIA13–UIA16 and UI L6–L10/DL2/DL6/DL9/DL10; B1/C3 playtest candidates P2/BFA3/BMC1/BLD2/BLD3/BHB2 and consolidated remainder groups; WG1–WG26; WPD-N1–N5/L1-Q1–Q4/L3-Q1–Q4; uncommitted review U1–U4; C2 follow-up and DEDUP open/R51/X6; and consolidated-table state definitions. Together B534–B539 cover original1–620 only. Original621–1169 remains unread in this range series. Each local code keeps its source and dated evidence; this is not a runtime audit of those rows.

F2: Equivalence output coverage, generated bone handles, margin versus quality/trader saturation and reference baskets are specific investigations, not proof of current bad prices. Intentional profitable/creation loops are valid under AD22/AD38; a benchmark or value anchor does not impose forced balance. DRC economic mutation, sale-lot custody, lasting price/grant carrier and per-actor attention/stock reasons are different ownership seams. Known drink outcome and disabled-reason text remain observer-safe; do not reveal an unknown effect or private actor state merely to explain a refusal. Defeat cause from an active effect differs from being located in a combat zone; DRC15's proposed routing needs its actual current contract/reproduction, not a blanket new lethality policy.

F3: UI findings preserve resolution and chronology. Fractional geometry from text/letter spacing is not automatically padding failure; scaled screenshots and empty/sparse Reports do not prove a current row or fill defect. The table itself first describes UIA14 as scaled/unproved then later records L8 full-resolution confirmation at its later input; preserve that sequence without treating either as a fresh current observation. Type-role, contrast, static feedback, tooltip reading isolation and truncation proposals remain useful under current UI owners, with human feel optional under AD42. Fewer !important rules or a shrinking off-scale ledger does not prove a better layout or causal performance. Use actual populated1920/MacBook/1536 targets rather than restoring1366 tests.

F4: The B1 entry and partial-journey rows identify coverage/harness uncertainty, not established rendered-app defects or external project blockers. Later C2 startup MutationObserver/More-panel/select and import-await fixes recorded in GAME_MCP_LIMITS and later reviewed receipts supersede selected title-screen access failures. They do not prove an ordinary low-spoiler world start, all cultivation actions, a fresh-life carry model or desktop layout. Distinct manor chest/household stores need identity clarification before counts are merged. Deposit/travel/return/retrieve is more than a stored-item screenshot; wider royal/construction/furnishing/repair/combat/cultivation matrices remain their own receipt scope. C3 ownership and stopped patrol/probability candidate labels are dated, requiring current selected source and owner before repair. No old process is resumed here.

F5: WG1–WG26 preserve useful world-specific possibilities while explicitly rejecting compulsory breadth. Hostile ecology, night logistics, mission-information trading, calibrated procedures, training-transfer, school/home/letters, strain-dependent interpretation, reserve/food/rest, navigation, ambient tells, observer faculties, combat aftermath and long-time commemoration are not all-world gates. Everyday texture can be valuable in its own right and need not be justified only by a progression gate; WG7's narrow wording is an old slice boundary rather than a prohibition on lived-world play. Strong faculties, alternative causes and favorable conditions remain possible. No automatic suspicion, upkeep, random misreading, fatigue or generational simulation is inferred. Paused/inactive/parked source worlds stay unselected unless current direction changes them; the current Klein/HP developer routes supersede early candidate rankings only for their selected scope.

F6: WPD source identity, exact local claim/trigger/cost/counter, actual native owners, useful downstream outcome and meaningful changed-state persistence remain distinct requirements under AD35/AD36/AD43. Source catalogue/census or one service proposal does not certify a full world, end-to-end campaign or every primary scene. Frozen absence is not a missing season, a service expiry is not erased competence, source-loop operation is not a generic restart and a sample certificate is not permanent truth about all water. Named franchise mechanisms stay with actual source/era/setting and original additions retain proposal labels. No source prose, sealed payload, acquisition or new world build was opened or selected here.

F7: Uncommitted U1–U4 retain concrete historical defects and integration boundaries: cross-life transferred identity versus checkpoint restore, preserving the book/slate/read/return/examine consumer, copied test API versus actual exports, and live rust-setting/penalty rollback after rejected persistence. The C1 repaired candidate for U3 is not automatic primary integration. Explicit fictional duplication is different from accidental identity replay. DEDUP R51 is already fixed at its recorded scope and prefix renaming resolves selected old collisions, while remaining clone/bulk/proposal-surface items require their real owners and no sealed identifiers. Existing rows do not authorize deleting records, removing worktrees, copying a stale tree, resetting saves or forcing commits. Consolidated state terms are evidence labels; blocked in this table may mean a historical pause and is not a current three-turn blocker finding for this reconciliation.
reviews.evidence: Original511–540,541–580,581–620 read completely. Prior B534–B538 cover1–510. Current-lane corrections refer to already reviewed GAME_MCP_LIMITS/receipts, not a fresh gameplay/source probe. Original621–1169 remains uncredited.
reviews.reopen: Continue original621–1169, then appended notes and cumulative actual-range/input verification before full-file credit.
